title: Other Runtime test files always exit; failing tests named in a stopped run
goal: No test file that starts Runtimes can hold the Windows test step past its limit, and a stopped run names each failed test
acceptance: test/watch-runtime.test.ts (run 45314998906: 'F-026: stopping a watch while it waits for approval…' cancelled at 30 s, file never finished) closes its Runtime in a hook that runs after a cancelled test, with a failing-first test as in B-118-T02
The other test files that start Runtimes get the same teardown, or a shared helper does it for all of them
The timing reporter records each failed test as it happens, so a stopped run names it (the spec report queues files behind the hung one)
Why worker-link-admission still fails on Windows is named from that record
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-24 from B-118-T02 (same mechanism, one more file plus the reporter). Not a measurement. Closed 2026-11-26.

prs.note: shared teardown scope, exit guard preload, failed tests logged as they happen
